title: Design: Asset Invoices tab lists a closed internal work order as No Charge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a closed internal work order on the asset, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-24-10b-asset-invoices-tab.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the asset's page.
  2. Click the Invoices tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The asset page opens.

Step 2:

  • The closed work order is listed with the status Closed, the Internal badge, Total balance "No Charge", and Discount and Tax rate empty, dated by the posting date; the row has no actions.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S3-R6: “The asset Invoices tab lists the closed work order with status Closed, the badge, Total balance "No Charge" and Discount and Tax rate empty (rows on that tab have no actions). The customer's Invoices tab (the receivables ledger) does not list it; the customer's Work Orders tab does (S2-R10). GET /api/invoices/list leaves it out too (no screen uses it today). Customer statements, the customer balance and credit limit checks do not include it, and no message driven by an open balance can pick it up, since it carries none. The Finance tab menu of the closed work order offers Reopen Work Order only (S4-R1); Issue Credit is not shown, as there is nothing to credit.”
  • S9-R10: “The asset's Invoices tab lists the closed internal and no-charge work orders with the badge, Total balance "No Charge" and Discount and Tax rate empty, dated by the posting date, so the history per unit is there; cost and hours are in the NO CHARGE document (columns are v1.1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 1 · Create and close", board "10b Asset · Invoices tab" (Flow 1 · Create and close).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow1-24-10b-asset-invoices-tab.png

The design's own words:

  • “Closed”
  • “No Charge”

Difference: the design shows the No Charge badge on an internal work order: register IWO-D16, settled by S2-R3. The Total balance cell shows "No Charge" as the PRD says and the design draws (the Jira check-list's "$0.00" is settled by the tech plan, which builds "No Charge"); this case is not held.
